candidates.place_reason: 306d audit 2026-10-13: the fit is 0.4 m/px rot 0 (8 anchors centred on the site point, resid 0), but the drawn W. Cotton schematic dun (the plate's own footnote: 'much too geometrical in drawing': barrow circles, a 'slight wall' dimensioned 254, walls 13 ft and 5 ft thick, an outer vallum, arcs opening SW) is both on the wrong side of the headland and ~2.2-2.3x too big: the plate's own 254-ft dimension (77 m drawn at ~443 px) implies ~0.17 m/px, not the fitted 0.4 (drawn vallum ~860 m vs the real headland ~250 m wide / ~600 m long), and the drawn system's centre lands ~130 m SSE of the site point (the Green Cone/Lawn at the headland's base) while the real fort's three ramparts (NHLE 1004300, the grassy ridge in the aerial) are ~100-150 m NW. Document deleted.
